title: ジャパンカップの後に・怒涛王のキモチ

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I have lost to Doto… For me to have been defeated by her, despite my awakening… What a joyous achievement!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Yet, Doto's heart is set—not to be my enemy… but a mutual motivator. An eternal rival, it is!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: Rivalry—something which a ruler requires—will help me achieve the power to overthrow the Golden Generation! With this settled, the stage is ready.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The Golden Generation awaits at the final battleground… the Arima Kinen!
